name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task explicitly requires the agent to find the key, but no hard Existence(key_found) clause is present. Add a hard Existence(key_found) clause to capture this requirement. All other clauses correctly encode the remaining sequence.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "Existence(key_found)" is redundant – the ordering rules already imply that key_found must occur to allow key pickup and door opening, so it can be removed without changing the accepted runs.  In addition, the task explicitly requires the agent to pick up the key, but no clause forces the event has_matching_key to occur.  Add a hard clause Existence(has_matching_key) to ensure key pickup.

texts: The key must be picked up eventually
The key must be found before picking it up
The key must be carried before opening the locked door
The locked door must be open before entering the target room
The target room must be entered before picking up the ball
The ball must be picked up eventually
